This draft retains independently reviewable component evidence while all eight joint acceptance gates remain **HOLD**.

Current immutable checkpoint: [complete evidence record](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/7c97a2f390f6ae7ef4b449e5f2ed6a81b755e0aa/evidence/joint-components-20261105/README.md), **1,564 files / 67,306,687 bytes**. The complete snapshot Git tree was recomputed locally and matched the remote tree; all other source and evidence entries remain unchanged. Earlier failed candidates and receipts remain in history.

## Findings and actual execution

- **Chain C4**, source `8df4b21d893906570d48f5beafabb3b31e0aefbc`, remains fixed in Chain PR #724. Original applicability, four-kernel, 30-shard legal-v3, 13-arm reused-v3, full-limb from-zero and two-target Sparse component runs/readers passed. Complete raw archives and actual ELF bytes are now retained in this checkpoint, with independent arithmetic reconstruction.
- **W1 cost:** the measured from-zero invalid-input campaign costs 21.862656 ms CPU including its one-time material, versus 427.969566 ms production verification CPU: **19.5753693421×** aggregate amplification. These exact phases exclude wire/send/admission/queue/storage/network costs and do not establish a global attacker minimum. The original public-service resource/confirmation gate remains unexecuted on an authorized hosted fixture; queued or dynamic aggregate status receives no credit.
- **Hepta H1**, source `9f785cb201ba12ab0ae0f0d341c0f7912cc65efc`, actually failed at the original PQ-owner gate (9 passed / 2 failed). The settled-absence recovery-read defect and exact reached assertions are retained.
- **Hepta H2**, source `620cb63ae9b58904483005bcb2c4e1507df99539`, fixes that narrow recovery defect, then actually fails after **70 completed selections** at the real daemon crash/recovery case's **original 60.007-second timeout**. Later gates were not run. All 96 original small artifacts, all 10 actual FD configs, source/configuration checks and independent timeout review are retained. H1/H2 actual-image archive creation succeeded remotely; full bulk readback remains separately pending, and H2's incomplete second copy never receives complete-image credit.
- **Hepta H3**, source `6db78eca53a5acdda0d96873d3f4cd65863426f0`, tree `e91f5994017fc5d2cfe58d405a20ee6ad9376772`, is frozen. It retains the actual first daemon image/file descriptor for strictly identified reuse and migrates the remaining native snapshot test inputs. The original-budget 74-selection native sequence was launched at 21:40:34.380 UTC and is **running / unqualified at this checkpoint**. No H1/H2 result is inherited. [Exact seven-path comparison](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/compare/620cb63ae9b58904483005bcb2c4e1507df99539...6db78eca53a5acdda0d96873d3f4cd65863426f0).

## Learning and remaining conditions

Two independently reviewed automatic model workflows have different input behavior. The current study-v1 producer rejects before training because it omits mandatory snapshot fields. Public-initial-v2 already supplies those fields and has a reachable path to fresh actual training without importing the earlier spent=1/1 trial record. **No H3 PR is opened under the existing no-new-learning-trial constraint.** The frozen source branch and comparison remain reviewable; no CI was modified, disabled, skipped or cancelled to work around this boundary.

The generic all-sink current-PQ owner bridge, independently retained recovery frontier, authentic complete-model/owner/snapshot inputs, valid hidden/future learning evidence, affordable paid long-term storage and the independent multi-admin WAN run remain open. No protected merge, activation, trial reset, substitute production key or relaxed acceptance gate is requested.

This evidence branch is based on historical `1556a4df6e279055fd8196f81a4ca2fe0f19384a`. It is an evidence carrier, not the H1, H2 or H3 execution candidate. Source, configuration, dependencies, actual binaries, fixtures and deployment scopes remain distinct.
